title: Asked a non-Eastern tester for their city during onboarding
origin: Decision on GitHub issue #21 (Yanni, Oct 27): the city question moves to plan agreement
testerLines: Hey! I'm Jordan, I want to read every day
mostly sci-fi, I've got a kindle and read in bed
whatWentWrong: Before the fix, ZOH asked "What city are you in?" before the last plan question for any number outside Eastern.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH never asks Jordan's city, location or time zone during onboarding, and never mentions time zones. Onboarding otherwise proceeds normally; once its questions are done, ZOH carries straight on into the plan (asks what the plan still needs, or shows it), with no recap and no "plan is on its way" line, and only then may it ask Jordan's city for the plan.
